title: Pale Blue Dot from Voyager 1 - PIA23645.png
author: NASA/JPL-Caltech
description: For the 30th anniversary of one of the most iconic images taken by NASA's Voyager mission, a new version of the image known as "the Pale Blue Dot." Planet Earth is visible as a bright speck within the sunbeam just right of center and appears softly blue, as in the original version published in 1990
